title: Brand it as yours + easier install
notes: Upload your own favicon in Admin → Settings (next to your logo). The install guide now offers a real prebuilt download zip plus Composer commands. The Flarum importer is now covered by an automated mapping test.

changelog.text: Upload your own favicon in Admin → Settings, next to your logo.
Install guide now has a prebuilt download zip plus Composer commands.
Flarum importer is now covered by an automated end-to-end mapping test.
